heroTitle:
Virtual Hardware Controller Deck
Recreated in Chrome Side Panel
heroSubtitle: Solves the frustrations of small touch UI elements and accidental inputs during video calls or playback in Chromebook tablet mode. Offers physical-like rotary knobs, toggle switches, and dedicated hardware decks.
problemCardTitle: Small UI Buttons and Input Limitations
problemCardDesc: Using Chromebooks detached from physical keyboards introduces unique Web app usability issues.
problem1: Small mute and camera toggle buttons in video calls (Meet / Teams) are difficult to tap accurately with fingers.
problem2: Switching tabs/windows to adjust volume or pause videos during full-screen playback is cumbersome.
problem3: High risk of accidentally hitting the leave-call button while tapping around touch controls.
problem4: Deep menu hierarchies when adjusting zoom, font size, or dark mode in documents and e-books.
solutionCardTitle: Persistent Large Touch Deck in Side Panel
solutionCardDesc: Leverages Chrome Side Panel UI to reproduce tactile feedback and physical hardware layout.
solution1: Ultra-large touch targets (64px+) with intuitive Pointer Events feedback.
solution2: Persistent side panel UI accessible without interrupting active web pages.
solution3: Protective cover flip switches preventing accidental leave-call operations.
solution4: 5 preset hardware decks switchable with a single tap.
policyLocalOnlyDesc: All data and processing remain strictly on your local Chromebook. Zero network requests made to external servers.
policyZeroTrackingDesc: Zero user activity tracking, analytics, or telemetry scripts. Complete protection of user privacy.
policyPureJsDesc: Built using Pure Vanilla Web Stack without build tools (Webpack/Vite) or external libraries. Clean, transparent code.
policyLocalBackupDesc: Deck configurations and settings can be backed up or restored via local JSON files, independent of cloud services.
mediaDeckDesc: Seamless control over web media players (YouTube, Spotify). Dial volume precisely with large rotary knobs.
meetingDeckDesc: Supercharge Google Meet & Microsoft Teams controls. Features safe flip switches with protective covers.
readerDeckDesc: Optimize reading environments for web articles, PDFs, and e-books. Adjust font size and display mode in one tap.
audioDeckDesc: Multi-channel volume mixing and master equalizer. Fine-tune per-tab audio balance and sound effects.
standardDeckDesc: Smooth multi-tab operations for daily Chromebook use. Switch tabs, create tabs, and trigger quick actions.
installStep1Desc: Clone or download the repository ZIP file and extract it.
installStep2Desc: Navigate to chrome://extensions/ in Chrome and enable Developer mode in top right.
installStep3Desc: Click 'Load unpacked' and select the `projects/app` directory.
installStep4Desc: Select 'DeskDeck-Solo' from Chrome's Side Panel icon to begin using.
faq1Q: Q: Does it communicate with external servers?
faq1A: A: No. DeskDeck-Solo runs entirely locally (Local-Only / Zero-Tracking) and performs zero network calls.
faq2Q: Q: Can I use it on desktop PCs with mouse/keyboard?
faq2A: A: Yes! Full support for mouse dragging, mouse wheel, and keyboard shortcuts is built-in.
faq3Q: Q: Can I customize and backup deck layouts?
faq3A: A: Yes. You can rebind slots in Options or export/import your configuration as a local JSON file.
